vision: Improve useful media quality within this Mac’s resources using only installed weights.
status: Both competing media chats checkpointed and rendering paused. Image and video baseline attempts blocked before model loading by warning memory pressure; no new media generated.
abstract: Add conservative quality presets, one-image reference editing and phase-wise model release. Evaluate actual outputs and retain failed or blocked attempts.

experiments.name: 512px low-memory baseline
experiments.purpose: Compare subject detail and requested composition.
experiments.command: bash shared/bin/run-image.sh 'Generate a detailed studio photograph of a small red robot reading a book beside a blue lamp. Clean composition, high quality, studio lighting.' --preset draft --seed 729 --output evidence/media-quality-20261105/image-draft.png

experiments.name: 768px image quality
experiments.purpose: Compare subject detail and requested composition.
experiments.command: bash shared/bin/run-image.sh 'Generate a detailed studio photograph of a small red robot reading a book beside a blue lamp. Clean composition, high quality, studio lighting.' --preset quality --seed 729 --output evidence/media-quality-20261104/image-quality.png

experiments.name: Reference edit: blue lamp to green
experiments.purpose: Compare subject detail and requested composition.
experiments.command: bash shared/bin/run-image.sh 'A detailed studio photograph of the same small red robot reading the same open book, now beside a green lamp instead of a blue lamp. Preserve the robot, book, background, camera angle and composition.' --preset quality --seed 729 --reference-image evidence/media-quality-20261104/image-quality.png --output evidence/media-quality-20261104/image-reference.png

experiments.name: Short video baseline: 320 × 192
experiments.purpose: Establish baseline video generation within memory limits before quality presets.
experiments.command: bash shared/bin/run-video.sh 'A yellow toy car rolling slowly from left to right on a plain wooden table, natural daylight, fixed camera, steady motion.' --preset draft --seed 729 --output evidence/media-quality-20261105/video-draft.mp4

experiments.name: Short video: 384 × 224
experiments.purpose: Review temporal consistency, motion and detail.
experiments.command: bash shared/bin/run-video.sh 'A yellow toy car rolling slowly from left to right on a plain wooden table, natural daylight, fixed camera, steady motion.' --preset quality --seed 729 --output evidence/media-quality-20261104/video-quality.mp4

experiments.name: Short video: 512 × 288
experiments.purpose: Review temporal consistency, motion and detail.
experiments.command: bash shared/bin/run-video.sh 'A yellow toy car rolling slowly from left to right on a plain wooden table, natural daylight, fixed camera, steady motion.' --preset detail-short --seed 729 --output evidence/media-quality-20261104/video-detail-short.mp4

Advance to quality presets/reference editing only after successful bounded baselines. No larger downloads or lower limits.
